from datetime import datetime
import calendar

# Load the workbook

# Target range: I2:K6
# I: May 2022, J: Jun 2022, K: Jul 2022

    'I': (2022, 5),
    'J': (2022, 6),
    'K': (2022, 7)
}

# We need to calculate the number of records open by the end of each month for each department in G2:G6
# A record is open if:
# 1. It was not closed before the first day of the month (Closed Date >= 1st of month OR Closed Date is None)
# 2. It was not created after the last day of the month (Created Date <= last day of month)

# Let's pre-calculate the dates for the months
month_bounds = {}
for col, (year, month) in months.items():
    first_day = datetime(year, month, 1)
    last_day_num = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    last_day = datetime(year, month, last_day_num)
    month_bounds[col] = (first_day, last_day)
